decision.about: How does an agent mark a decision as the owner's alone?

options.why: one small opt-in, keeps every other decision decided-by-default
more explicit but doubles the walk's surface for a rare case

decision.because: less surface; a decision is owner-only by exception, not by a whole separate path.

decision.about: Where does clearing an owner's own override land?

options.say: back to the system's own pick
options.why: the record is still status:decided — reverting to nothing chosen would misrepresent it as undecided
simpler, but wrong for a record the system already settled

decision.because: a decide.mjs record is never actually undecided; clearing an override just un-does the OWNER's part, not the system's.

decision.about: Where does the scroll-safe tap guard live?

options.why: no new reserved word on View; only this widget changes
reusable, but a new View method is a reserved word for every page's config (code#7)

decision.because: code skill #7 warns a new core View method becomes a config reserved word for every page; this bug is local to one widget.

assign.title: Decisions decided by default; fixed the accidental-tap bug
assign.outcome:
**Decided by default; a stray tap can no longer silently "choose" something.**
- [x] Decided by default: `Server/decide.mjs` now writes `status:"decided", decided_by:"system"` (the recommended option, alternatives beside it) unless `--owner-only "<reason>"` — [decide.md](/Server/doc/decide.md), 23/23 selftest checks pass.
- [x] UI bug fixed: a tap that lands mid-scroll is ignored, tapping the chosen option again clears it, "chosen by the system" vs "your choice" shown distinctly (dashed vs solid border) — proof, headless + real browser: ![before/after](proof/1-initial-chosen-by-system.png) [full steps.json](proof/steps.json).
- [x] Traced who acts on a `chose` line: Servex's Cards.js wakes the agent that asked; no mastermind auto-branches off one otherwise — answered on [the audio card](/framework/ai2/2026/09/29/audio-a-library-of-audio-parts-transcrip/).
- Left: the branch-review flow (`review.mjs`) assumes a feature branch merged via `merge.mjs`; this landed directly on `michael/dev` per the brief, so verification was the selftest suite plus the headless proof and a live-page smoke test instead.
